nodes.label: RiskWise Mother Context (Full Docs)
nodes.author: Manus AI
nodes.rationale: Complete documentation of the Manus-built version of RiskWise (v2.4.1). Covers all pages, backend routes, agent structure, DB schema, and deployment details. Source of truth for understanding what exists before the portability rework.

nodes.label: RouteAnalyzer Page
nodes.rationale: Interactive route risk evaluation page. Natural language query parser extracts origin/destination. Shows agent monitoring terminal, risk score ring, 4-factor breakdown bars, narrative, and Apollo alternative routes panel. Core MVP feature, kept with minor styling cleanup.

nodes.label: ActiveDisruptions Page
nodes.rationale: Live threat feed with category/severity filters, data freshness badges (green/amber/grey), auto-refresh every 60s. Events from RSS (GDELT/BBC/AJZ/NYT), NASA EONET, USGS, Country Risk Index with deduplication. Core MVP feature, kept.

nodes.label: RouteHistory Page
nodes.rationale: Paginated past evaluation cards with re-run, expandable risk narrative, data provenance, and trend sparkline (AreaChart). Trend sparklines deferred in MVP scope trim. Core MVP feature, kept.

nodes.label: MapView Page
nodes.rationale: Google Maps integration with dark style, disruption markers, route overlays, layer toggles. Alternate route visualization layers removed in scope trim (Phase 4). CORS handled via fetch()+Blob URL approach. Fallback schematic if Maps fails.

nodes.label: Real-Time Data Fetchers
nodes.rationale: 4 real-time data sources feeding Athena: RSS OSINT (BBC/AJZ/NYT/GDELT) for geopolitical/labor, NASA EONET for weather/volcanoes, USGS earthquakes M5.0+, Osiris Country Risk Index. No API keys needed. server/realtime.ts kept as-is.

nodes.label: Database Schema (users, risk_events, shipping_routes, route_evaluations)
nodes.rationale: 5 tables: users (auth), risk_events (disruptions), shipping_routes (base route definitions), route_evaluations (agent results + riskNarrative + intelligenceSummary + dataSources), heartbeat_jobs (removed in portability rework). Migrating from MySQL to PostgreSQL syntax.

nodes.label: RiskWiseLayout Component
nodes.rationale: Sidebar nav with logo (neon glow to be removed), SYSTEM ONLINE pulse indicator (pulse kept here only), 4 navigation items, agent list. Top header with mobile toggle, UTC timestamp, live agent count. Kept with minor glow restraint edits.

nodes.label: Risk Scoring Logic (0-100, 4-factor)
nodes.rationale: Risk score 0-100 across weather, labor, geopolitical, congestion factors. Thresholds: green 0-30, amber 31-60, red 61-75, critical 76+. Critical alerts (score > 75) trigger notifyOwner(). Logic in client/src/lib/riskUtils.ts, kept as-is.
